dataSource.query:
AIQRunsV1()
| extend Value = tolower(replace_string(Region, ' ', ''))
| distinct Value
| project Value, Label = Value
| order by Value asc

AIQRunsV1()
| where tolower(replace_string(Region, ' ', '')) == _region
| project Value = ScoringPolicy, Label = ScoringPolicy
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

AIQSnapshotsV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| project Value = FrameworkRunId, Label = strcat(format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), ' / ', FrameworkRunId), ReportDate
| order by ReportDate desc
| project Value, Label

let Selected = AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1;
AIQUnitsV1()
| where FrameworkRunId in (Selected | project FrameworkRunId) or FrameworkRunId in (Selected | project PreviousRunId)
| project Value = Agent, Label = Agent
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| extend Value = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| project Value, Label = Value
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value desc

AIQDailyAgents()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where isempty(_reportDate) or format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') == _reportDate
| project Value = Agent, Label = Agent
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1
| project ReportDate, QualityScore, C_E = strcat(CorrectIssues, '/', ExpectedIssues), M = MissedIssues, N = NoiseCards, D = DuplicateCards, ExcludedUnits
tiles.title: Latest stored quality — C/E detected/scored issues; M misses; N Noise; D Duplicates

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| extend Series = strcat(PolicyLabel, ' / ', RegionKey, ' / ', CoveragePolicy)
| project ReportDate, QualityScore, Series, ComparisonNote
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Stored quality trend — selected policy only; check coverage and rotation limits below

tiles.query:
let Latest = materialize(AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1);
union
(Latest | project Metric = 'C — detected issues', Previous = PreviousCorrect, Current = CorrectIssues, Change = DeltaCorrect, PreviousWeighted = real(null), CurrentWeighted = real(null)),
(Latest | project Metric = 'M — missed scored issues', Previous = PreviousMissed, Current = MissedIssues, Change = DeltaMissed, PreviousWeighted = PreviousWeightedMisses, CurrentWeighted = WeightedMisses),
(Latest | project Metric = 'N — Noise cards', Previous = PreviousNoise, Current = NoiseCards, Change = DeltaNoise, PreviousWeighted = PreviousWeightedNoise, CurrentWeighted = WeightedNoise),
(Latest | project Metric = 'D — Duplicate cards', Previous = PreviousDuplicates, Current = DuplicateCards, Change = DeltaDuplicates, PreviousWeighted = PreviousWeightedDuplicates, CurrentWeighted = WeightedDuplicates)
| extend WeightedChange = CurrentWeighted - PreviousWeighted
| order by Metric asc
tiles.title: Latest vs previous snapshot — count changes and denominator penalties, not causal attribution

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| project ReportDate, PreviousDate, IssueCoverage = strcat(ScoredIssues, '/', PlannedIssues), PreviousIssues = iff(isempty(PreviousRunId), '', strcat(PreviousScoredIssues, '/', PreviousPlannedIssues)), BaselineCoverage = strcat(ScoredBaselines, '/', PlannedBaselines), PreviousBaselines = iff(isempty(PreviousRunId), '', strcat(PreviousScoredBaselines, '/', PreviousPlannedBaselines)), ExcludedUnits, PreviousExcluded, ComparisonNote
| order by ReportDate desc
tiles.title: Coverage and comparison limits — scored/planned units; excluded units are not misses

tiles.query:
let Selected = materialize(AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1);
let CurrentRun = toscalar(Selected | project FrameworkRunId);
let PreviousRun = toscalar(Selected | project PreviousRunId);
AIQUnitsV1()
| where FrameworkRunId in (CurrentRun, PreviousRun)
| where isempty(_currentAgent) or Agent == _currentAgent
| summarize C = sumif(CorrectIssues, Scorable and Kind == 'issue'), E = sumif(ExpectedIssues, Scorable and Kind == 'issue'), N = sumif(NoiseCards, Scorable), D = sumif(DuplicateCards, Scorable), ExcludedUnits = countif(not(Scorable)), Issues = countif(Scorable and Kind == 'issue'), PlannedIssues = countif(Kind == 'issue'), Baselines = countif(Scorable and Kind == 'baseline'), PlannedBaselines = countif(Kind == 'baseline') by Agent, FrameworkRunId, ReportDate
| project Agent, Snapshot = iff(FrameworkRunId == CurrentRun, 'Current', 'Previous'), ReportDate, C_E = strcat(C, '/', E), M = E - C, N, D, IssueCoverage = strcat(Issues, '/', PlannedIssues), BaselineCoverage = strcat(Baselines, '/', PlannedBaselines), ExcludedUnits
| order by Agent asc, ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Agent counts — current and previous snapshots; baselines add penalties, not a score bonus

tiles.query:
let SelectedRun = toscalar(AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1
| project FrameworkRunId);
AIQUnitChangesV1(SelectedRun)
| where isempty(_currentAgent) or Agent == _currentAgent
| project Agent, LogicalVersion, ExpectedIssueAlias, Kind, Previous = strcat(PreviousStatus, '; C/E ', PreviousC, '/', PreviousE, '; M/N/D ', PreviousM, '/', PreviousN, '/', PreviousD), Current = strcat(CurrentStatus, '; C/E ', C, '/', E, '; M/N/D ', M, '/', N, '/', D), DeltaC, DeltaM, DeltaN, DeltaD, CurrentReasons, PreviousReasons
| order by Agent asc, LogicalVersion asc
tiles.title: Which units changed? — blank counts/deltas mean excluded, not planned, or no previous snapshot

tiles.query:
let SelectedRun = toscalar(AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1
| project FrameworkRunId);
AIQFindingsV1()
| where FrameworkRunId == SelectedRun
| where isempty(_currentAgent) or Agent == _currentAgent
| summarize Cards = count() by Agent, LogicalVersion, Kind, Scored, Classification, ExclusionReasons = tostring(ExclusionReasons)
| order by Scored asc, Agent asc, LogicalVersion asc, Classification asc
tiles.title: Finding counts — scored and unscored stay separate; unexpected real findings are not Noise

tiles.query:
AIQSnapshotChangesV1()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where RegionKey == _region and ScoringPolicy == _policy
| where isempty(_snapshot) or FrameworkRunId == _snapshot
| sort by ReportDate desc, SnapshotOrder desc
| take 1
| project ReportDate, PreviousDate, ComparisonNote, Metadata = bag_pack('FrameworkRunId', FrameworkRunId, 'PreviousRunId', PreviousRunId, 'SourceCommit', SourceCommit, 'PreviousSourceCommit', PreviousSourceCommit, 'Region', Region, 'ScoringPolicy', ScoringPolicy, 'ScoreFormula', ScoreFormula, 'NoiseWeight', NoiseWeight, 'DuplicateWeight', DuplicateWeight, 'MissWeight', MissWeight, 'CoveragePolicy', CoveragePolicy)
tiles.title: Selected snapshot and comparison limits — expand Metadata for source and recorded policy

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| project ReportDate, QualityScore, Series = QualityScoreFormula
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Legacy stored scores — historical formulas; never compare this line as a v2 Engine change

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where isempty(_reportDate) or format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') == _reportDate
| project ReportDate, QualityScore, IssuesCorrect, IssuesExpected, IssuesMissing, NoiseCards, DuplicateCards, QualityScoreFormula
| order by ReportDate desc
tiles.title: Legacy daily counts — original meanings and stored score retained

tiles.query:
AIQDailyIssues()
| where ReportDate between (startofday(_startTime) .. startofday(_endTime))
| where isempty(_reportDate) or format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| project ReportDate, Agent, IssueId, Outcome, CardCount, RuntimeEvidenceComplete
| order by ReportDate desc, Agent asc, IssueId asc
tiles.title: Legacy issue outcomes — read-only historical context
